meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出代码改动或系统结构的动态架构图与数据流图,让变更一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要跟人解释一段代码改动或系统结构,却只能靠文字硬讲
copy.tagline_en: Draw a code change or system as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often explain code changes or systems and words alone fall short

howto.what: 安装后,当你要求把一次代码改动或某段代码画成图时,Claude 会先写一份 JSON 文档,校验通过后渲染成带动画的 SVG 架构图或数据流图,并可以发布成链接或附到 PR 里。
howto.when: 当你提到 PR Lens、diagram、architecture 等关键词,或要求把改动或系统画成图、解释架构、给 PR 配图时触发。

say.text: 把这个分支的改动画成架构图,给我一个链接
say.note: 渲染后推送到画布,返回只读视图链接

say.text: 在这条 PR 的描述里附上架构图,用 light 主题
say.note: 先渲染 SVG,再用 gh 附加到 PR

say.text: 把新的批处理流程画成数据流图,并加一段导览
say.note: 生成 flow 视图和 walkthrough 步骤

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a code change or part of a codebase into a JSON document that validates and renders as an animated SVG architecture or data-flow diagram, then publishes it as a canvas link or attaches it to a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention PR Lens, diagram, architecture or similar keywords, ask to diagram or explain a change or a system, or want a diagram on a pull request.

say_en.text: Diagram this branch's changes as an architecture view and give me a link
say_en.note: Renders and pushes to a canvas, returning the view link

say_en.text: Attach the architecture diagram to this pull request, light theme
say_en.note: Renders the SVG and attaches it with gh

say_en.text: Draw the new batch flow as a data-flow diagram with a walkthrough
say_en.note: Builds a flow view and walkthrough steps
